title: Understanding OLS
text: The ordinary least squares (OLS) method is used to find the best-fitting line through the data points. It minimizes the sum of the squared differences between the observed values and the values predicted by the line.

title: OLS and Predictions
text: OLS minimizes the sum of squared differences between the actual values and the predicted values. This means it tries to make the predictions as close as possible to the actual data points.
